title: Reduced models & neural operators
contribution: I compared four reduced or learned approximations with a full-order Burgers solver, including unseen initial-condition tests.
result: ROM error: 0.152% in-distribution; 1.7% on the tested unseen initial-condition family.
purpose: Comparing fast approximations of nonlinear transport.
image_alt: Three in-distribution test cases comparing ground truth, POD-ROM, DEIM-ROM, MLP surrogate, and FNO solutions of the viscous Burgers' equation
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Data assimilation for chaotic Lorenz-96
contribution: I implemented and independently checked an ensemble Kalman filter, then studied localisation, ensemble size, and filter failure.
result: Over 11× RMSE reduction at the best tested localisation radius, relative to the unlocalised baseline.
purpose: Estimating chaotic system states from noisy observations.
image_alt: Assimilation RMSE versus Gaspari-Cohn localisation radius, showing over an eleven-fold reduction relative to the unlocalized baseline at the best tested radius
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Optimal mixing of passive scalars
contribution: My 2021 M.Sc. thesis studied bounds on passive-scalar mixing (University of L’Aquila; supervisor: Prof. Stefano Spirito). The subsequent Python implementation and numerical report extend that work.
result: Exponential mixing in the tested cases, with resolution-dependent fitted decay rates.
purpose: Understanding how stirring accelerates scalar mixing.
image_alt: Plot of log H-1 mix norm decaying linearly over time, alongside conserved L2, L4 and L8 norms
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: LLM systems & model compression
contribution: I developed a collection of LLM projects, including FinBERT pruning and knowledge distillation with saved evaluation results.
result: FinBERT student: 96.91% accuracy and 0.9691 weighted F1 on a 453-sentence test split.
purpose: Building and evaluating practical language-model systems.
image_alt: FinBERT model compression: Teacher model to Compression to Student model

title: Sparse-view photoacoustic reconstruction
contribution: I compared time-reversal reconstruction with learned U-Net refinement on synthetic acoustic data and investigated disagreement between image metrics.
result: +11.8 dB PSNR at 16 sensors; whole-image SSIM is lower despite improved foreground structure.
purpose: Reconstructing images from sparse acoustic measurements.
image_alt: Grid comparing ground truth, time-reversal, and learned-refinement photoacoustic reconstructions across four test phantoms, with the learned reconstructions visibly closer to ground truth and higher PSNR at every sparsity setting
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Differentiable material recovery
contribution: I implemented a differentiable Cook–Torrance renderer in PyTorch and optimised material maps using six of eight reference views.
result: Held-out-view MSE: 1.02×10⁻⁵, approximately 5.6× the training-view error.
purpose: Recovering surface materials from multiple images.
image_alt: Recovered albedo, normal, roughness and metallic material maps from differentiable PBR optimisation
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Finite-element cylinder-flow benchmarks
contribution: I implemented a Taylor–Hood solver and evaluated geometry, mesh, time-step, and force-definition effects against cylinder-flow benchmarks.
result: Verified O(h³)/O(h²) velocity convergence; complete unsteady benchmark reproduction is not claimed.
purpose: Measuring solver accuracy on standard cylinder-flow problems.
image_alt: Velocity magnitude with streamlines, pressure field, and vorticity field around the cylinder at the finest 2D-1 steady mesh
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Flight data monitoring dashboard
contribution: At Intuos Srl, I developed a dashboard serving flight-phase classifiers and operational analytics over recorded telemetry.
result: 0.999 weighted F1 in five-fold row-level cross-validation; flight-, aircraft-, and time-held-out evaluation not established.
purpose: Helping analysts explore recorded flights and flight phases.
image_alt: Flight data monitoring: IBM DB2 to FastAPI to React dashboard

title: Topology optimisation with verified FEM
contribution: I implemented a 2D elasticity solver and SIMP optimiser, verifying displacement convergence and compliance sensitivities.
result: Cantilever compliance: 617.9 → 101.4 after 150 iterations; the mesh study is not yet quantitatively converged.
purpose: Finding material layouts that resist loading with less material.
image_alt: Initial uniform-density cantilever design versus the final SIMP-optimized density field after 150 optimality-criteria iterations
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Navier–Stokes & reduced-order modelling
contribution: I implemented and verified a Fourier pseudo-spectral solver, then developed POD-Galerkin and DEIM reduced models.
result: 38.5× online speed-up at <0.1% mean state error on the training trajectory (rank 16).
purpose: Accelerating repeated simulations of incompressible flow.
image_alt: Full-order versus rank-32 reduced-order vorticity field snapshots at four time points, with the reduced-order model closely matching the full-order flow structure
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: NeRF & TensoRF from scratch
contribution: I implemented NeRF and TensoRF and compared reconstruction quality on a held-out set of 40 images.
result: TensoRF: 16.7 dB test PSNR versus 13.7 dB for NeRF, using half the training iterations.
purpose: Synthesising new views of a scene from photographs.
image_alt: Side-by-side spiral fly-around comparing NeRF and TensoRF novel-view renders of the same scene

title: Physics-informed advection–diffusion
contribution: I implemented a PINN and ran a five-seed study of value-only versus value-and-derivative periodic boundary losses.
result: Derivative mismatch fell 7–38×; global solution accuracy did not improve reliably.
purpose: Solving transport equations using physics-based training losses.
image_alt: Exact solution, PINN prediction, and pointwise absolute error for the historical value-only formulation of the 1D advection-diffusion PINN, seed 42

title: Bayesian Darcy permeability inversion
contribution: I implemented adjoint-based inversion and pCN sampling, checking the solver, gradients, and sampler against independent references.
result: 0.59% sampler validation error on a linear-Gaussian reference; full PDE posterior mixing remains limited.
purpose: Recovering underground permeability from pressure observations.
image_alt: True, reconstructed, and pointwise error log-permeability fields for the smooth-truth deterministic Darcy inversion
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: Phase-field multiphase flow
contribution: I implemented coupled phase-field, flow, and heat-transfer solvers and developed a dedicated 1D Stefan benchmark solver.
result: 0.079% interface-position error in the dedicated 1D Stefan test; physical 3D validation is pending.
purpose: Simulating coupled flow, heat transfer, and phase change.
image_alt: 2D vapour bubble growth benchmark: numerical bubble radius versus the analytical solution over time, alongside the final phase-field distribution showing a circular vapour bubble
image_caption: Research figure · open case study for context

title: 3D liver segmentation
contribution: I implemented a 3D U-Net training and inference workflow and a separate pipeline for leakage-controlled full-volume evaluation.
result: Dice 0.9886 on centre-cropped model-selection volumes; independent full-volume evaluation is pending.
purpose: Segmenting liver anatomy in volumetric CT images.
image_alt: Training loss and validation Dice curves over 200 epochs, showing Dice rising to 0.9886

title: Aircraft engine audio monitoring
contribution: I built a Raspberry Pi audio-processing pipeline with an ESP32 display interface and tested it on engine recordings.
result: Prototype tested on Tecnam P92 recordings; no tachometer ground truth and ~21% chunk-level order ambiguity.
purpose: Estimating engine behaviour from audio recordings.
image_alt: Audio-based engine monitoring: Microphone to Raspberry Pi to ESP32 display
